Trishakti Power Generation Corporation 
 PSU CLIENT · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 Reference Letter 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern 
 
 Ref: REF/42/48 Date: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern, 
 This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said agency
 
 has executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found
 satisfactory. 
 
 1. Project Details 
 
 Project Name Check Dam - Delhi Pkg-55 
 
 Scope of Work Irrigation works for Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
 
 completed 2017. 
 Nature of Work Irrigation 
 
 Contract Value INR 12.13 Cr 
 
 Date of Completion 2017-06-23 
 
 Contractor's Role Prime 
 
 
 2. Performance Assessment 
 
 Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was cooperative, with weekly progress reporting
 maintained without prompting, and . On that basis the agency is recommended for works of comparable
 scope and value. 
 
 Criterion Rating Observation 
 
 Adherence to Schedule Excellent Project delivered within contractual timeline
 
 Quality of Work Excellent Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications
 
 Safety Record Good BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout 
 
 Responsiveness Excellent Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs 
 
 Financial Integrity Good Billing was accurate and supported by records

3. Recommendation 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost, and their
 conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works.
 
 We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in the
 future. This reference is valid for a period of Medium from the date of this letter.
 
 4. Verification 
 
 For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter is issued
